curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: read sentences in a text accurately, at the right speed, and with expression for effective communication

interactions.prompt: Which version reads every word in “Rita rides the red bus”?
interactions.feedback: Accurate start! You kept every word in order.
interactions.retryHint: Touch each word from left to right.

interactions.prompt: Read: “Sam has a little rabbit.” Which words belong together smoothly?
interactions.feedback: Smooth phrasing! Those words make one clear idea.
interactions.retryHint: Find the words that describe what Sam has.

interactions.prompt: Read: “Please pass the salt.” Which voice sounds polite?
interactions.feedback: Beautiful expression! Your voice matches the polite words.
interactions.retryHint: Let the word please guide your voice.

interactions.prompt: Read: “Where is my red hat?” What should your voice do at the end?
interactions.feedback: Right! Your voice shows that the sentence asks a question.

interactions.prompt: Read: “We won the race! We are so happy!” Which performance is best?
choices: steady words with a joyful voice and short pauses
slow and sad with no pauses
interactions.answer: steady words with a joyful voice and short pauses
interactions.feedback: What a performance! Pace, accuracy, and feeling work together.
interactions.retryHint: Use the full stops and exclamation marks as your guide.

interactions.prompt: A listener understood every word and feeling. What did the reader most likely do?
choices: read accurately, smoothly, and with expression
interactions.answer: read accurately, smoothly, and with expression
interactions.feedback: Fluent-reader badge earned! Your reading can communicate meaning clearly.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the answer that combines all three fluency skills.
